parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. This parameter accepts only V2.0 subscription certificate instances (certificates purchased from a CA such as DigiCert or GeoTrust, with an InstanceId in the format of cas-cn-). Uploaded certificates (cas-upload-) are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 实例的 ID。该参数仅接受V2.0的订阅证书实例（从 CA 如 DigiCert/GeoTrust 购买的证书，InstanceId 格式 cas-cn-），不支持上传证书（cas-upload-）
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the certificate to revoke
parameters.name: certificate_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
